Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - CC/945/2021

Dear Ms. Kamath,

Thank you for meeting us on 7 June 2021 about your dispute with M/s Mishra Traders. As we understand it, the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Lucknow.

Our advice is to argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted. Please collect the written acknowledgement of the debt and the stop-payment memo and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of INR 24,80,000/-.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan
